what: Escaped double quotes are still parsed as terminators before the proposed unescape pass
scenario_or_breakage: The planned escape-quotes-only fixture using "say \"hi\"" is SKIPped because index(rest, quote) stops at the escaped quote before unescaping can run
suggested_fix: Replace literal_end=index(rest, quote) for double-quoted literals with a char scanner that treats only unescaped " as the closing delimiter, then unescape the captured body

what: The plan loses escape-state when checking for bare dollars after unescaping
scenario_or_breakage: If implementation follows the failure-mode mitigation and rescans the unescaped payload, "\${MISSING}" becomes ${MISSING} and is misclassified as interpolated instead of checkable
suggested_fix: Detect unescaped $ while scanning the original double-quoted source, before rewriting \$ to $, or carry an escaped flag through the unescape loop

what: Plain Bash read with IFS=$'\t' does not preserve empty TSV fields
scenario_or_breakage: The SKILL.md row needs an empty prompt_kind before step_markers, but Bash collapses adjacent tab delimiters so 2b,3b,4,5 shifts into prompt_kind and step placement never runs
suggested_fix: Parse the TSV with awk -F '\t' or another field-preserving parser, and have the malformed/empty-field tests cover the SKILL.md row shape
